prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hyper-realistic, cinematic close-up of a human eye, focusing on the upper half of the face. The subject’s skin is warm-toned and textured, with fine details of pores and subtle lines visible. The eye is open wide, revealing a striking hazel iris with flecks of gold and green, sharply in focus. Long, dark eyelashes frame the eye, and the eyebrow is partially visible at the top of the frame. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle highlights on the moist surface of the eye and creating a sense of depth. The background is blurred, drawing all attention to the intricate details of the eye and surrounding skin. The overall mood is intimate and contemplative, with a shallow depth of field and a slight cinematic grain, evoking the style of a high-definition film still or a fine art portrait.
